{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Earth Dog''' (戊戌, ''tsuchinoe inu''; onyomi ''bojutsu'') is the 35th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 35th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Fire Rooster|af|Vuurhaan (astrologie)|cdo|Dĭng-iū|de|Feuer-Hahn|fr|Coq de feu|hak|Tên-yû|ja|丁酉|ko|정유 (간지)|nds|Füür-Hahn|vi|Đinh Dậu|za|Dingyoux|zh|丁酉|zh_min_nan|Teng-iú|zh_yue|丁酉|qid=Q201551}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Earth Pig|af|Aardvark (astrologie)|cdo|Gī-hâi|de|Erde-Schwein|fr|Cochon de terre (Cycle sexagésimal chinois)|hak|Kí-hoi|ja|己亥|ko|기해|nds|Eer-Swien|vi|Kỷ Hợi|za|Geijhaih|zh|己亥|zh_min_nan|Kí-hāi|zh_yue|己亥|qid=Q904335}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''戊'' is Yang Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''戌'' (Dog) is Yang Earth; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==

** Japanese:

*** On'yomi: bojutsu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): musul (무술)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Mậu Tuất

=== Events ===
* In the 9th year of {{ill|Tenpō|en|Tenpō|qid=Q1369045|lt=Tenpō}} ({{ill|1838|en|1838|qid=Q7612|lt=1838 AD}}), {{ill|Takano Chōei|en|Takano Chōei|qid=Q944693|lt=Kōya Nagahide}} authored the work {{ill|Bojutsu Yume Monogatari|ja|戊戌夢物語|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxu Dream Tale|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11495335}}.
* In the 24th year of {{ill|Guangxu Era|ja|光緒|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Guangxu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1135852}} ({{ill|1898|en|1898|qid=Q7848|lt=1898 AD}}), during the Qing dynasty, the reforms and political upheaval known as the {{ill|Hundred Days' Reform|en|Hundred Days' Reform|qid=Q917709|lt=Wuxu Reform}} and the {{ill|Hundred Days' Reform|ja|戊戌の政変|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wuxu Coup|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=戊戌の変法|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q917709}} took place.
==Months of Yang Earth Dog==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (i.e. when the Ten Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)}} or {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)}}), the month of {{ill|September|en|September|qid=Q123|lt=September}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of Wuxu. However, the term “month” here may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Hanro}} until the day before {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Rittō}}) as applicable.
==Days of Yang Earth Dog==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日}} for a Wuxu day is as follows.
